motion_system: Hover pressure lives in the physical marks: selected sockets catch a millimeter of shadow lift, nearby dash rows compress, and edge notches breathe like small repairs under the wall skin.
color_drift: Nearly monochrome warm white, pale gray, charcoal, and matte silver, with rare muted G/F#/A pitch glints as cool green, pale yellow, and dusty blue inside a few connector mouths.
glow_behavior: No theatrical glow; only tiny anodized-metal catches, soft socket glints, and a dim bass pressure haze along the baseboard seam.
